govdocs-archive_org-LinaJriTheFightAgain: Juri Lina’s war on loan-sharking takes aim at money-lords through the ages. The Estonian’s pages fit the free-money shelf. Usury’s history is long and bitter. His pleas ask a hard look. The matter is still fought over. The book is a sample of mint-reform pleading.
personal-experiences-of-s-o-susag: S. O. Susag, a Norwegian immigrant, sets down his personal experiences — the crossing, the prairie homestead, the building of a new life. Plain and true, his memoir speaks for thousands of settlers. A precious voice from the immigrant past. His plain account of the crossing, the homestead, and neighborly help speaks for a generation of newcomers.
